answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the kernel check immediately, the quill audit keeps the resolved set and the wander replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 24 aliases thus pays the reading cost 24 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
